subject: spanish

moments.title: Modern bullfighting begins
moments.body: Romero introduces the use of the muleta and the killing sword.
moments.takeaway: What looks 'traditional' often has a specific date of invention.

moments.title: Catalan ban
moments.body: Catalonia bans bullfighting, partly as political distinction from Madrid.

moments.title: Spanish Constitutional Court
moments.body: The Court rules bullfighting is national heritage and overturns Catalonia's ban.
moments.takeaway: National heritage status protects controversial practices.

now.title: Bullfighting today
now.body: Audiences are declining and public subsidy is debated. Some autonomous communities limit or ban it.

reflection: Tradition is contested wherever it persists.
